title: Hold an exploration licence
what: Explore for minerals only under an exploration licence granted by the Minister, and only with an approved program for environment protection and rehabilitation in force.

sources.title: Mining Act 1971 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An exploration licence authorises the holder of the licence to carry out exploration operations of a kind described in the licence in respect of land described, or referred to, in the licence

sources.title: Mining Act 1971 (SA)

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. No general offence of exploring without a licence was found; the licence is what authorises exploration (s 29), and s 8(2) bars it in opal development areas without one. Reach and framework marks follow the NSW requirement for this family; to check.
